// RED fixture for `no-untagged-personal-data` — the IDENTITY-relevant slice (P-ID-03 / P-024).
// The lint MUST reject this. The S1 principal store carries profile PII (`email`, `display_name`)
// and S2 carries real-identity columns (`full_name`) — none are #[personal_data(...)]-tagged, so
// they escape the per-subject crypto-shred erase (ID-D8) and the RoPA/data-map fan-out: the
// un-erasable / un-mapped subject bug class (ADR-12). The opaque `principal_id` is correctly
// untagged (it is not PII); only the real-identity columns must carry the tag.
pub struct PrincipalRow {
    pub principal_id: PrincipalId,
    pub email: String,
    pub display_name: String,
    pub full_name: String,
    pub region: Region,
}
